item.title: Halloween Storytime with Mountain Buddies
item.description:
Date: Friday, October 30, 2026
Time: 10:30AM - 11:00AM
Location: Kid Zone
Type: Lafayette Library

Families - join us for a special Halloween Storytime, with musical guest, the Mountain Buddies. Little goblins, witches, and ghosts will have fun dancing to original silly Halloween tunes and enjoy some spooky stories. Costumes encouraged but not required!

item.title: Sensory Storytime
item.description:
Date: Saturday, October 31, 2026
Time: 10:30AM - 11:00AM
Presenter: Megan Dare, M.Ed., BCBA
Location: Conference Room
Type: Lafayette Library

Kids and caregivers: join us for Storytime designed for kids ages 2-8 who are neurodiverse and/or have sensory needs. This structured Storytime, with softer lighting, singing, books, and sensory toys, is led by a Board-Certified Behavior Analyst. 

Location: Conference Room (lower level) - note, this is a one-time change due to voting in the main meeting room.

item.title: Community Collections - Register
item.description:
Date: Sunday, November 1, 2026
Time: All Day Event
Location: Display - Fiction Area, Display Case - Across from Teen Zone
Type: Lafayette Library

All ages - have a cool collection you would like to show off? Sign up using the Begin Registration button to display it for a month in one of our two display cases upstairs!

We encourage kids and teens to sign up, but all are welcome! We have a horizontal and a vertical display case. Please state your preference when you sign up and we will be in touch.

  • We pick a new collection every month.
  • If a spot is not available, you may sign up for that month's waitlist or wait for the next month's registration to open.
    • You may register for the waitlist and will be notified if a spot becomes open for the month you selected. Waitlist signups are not moved to fill later months.
  • Registration opens at the beginning of the month for the next month.

Please bring in your items to complete your display no later than the fifth of the month or the display will move to the next person on the list.

item.title: Teen Maker Hangout - Drop In
item.description:
Date: Monday, November 2, 2026
Time: 4:30PM - 7:30PM
Location: Studio 775 Makerspace
Type: Lafayette Library

Teens in grades 6-12 - Drop in to use and explore the Library's Makerspace! Learn about the equipment we have, programs we offer, and tools available for making designs. Please note that hours can change due to staffing or special programs. We encourage you to check the calendar or call 303-661-1163 just ahead of your visit.

Before your first use of the equipment: A release must be on file for each person of any age using the space or supervising others in the space, and each user needs their own Lafayette Library card (not an online temporary account)  prior to filling out the Makerspace Release and Policies form (https://lafayetteco.gov/MakerspaceRelease). Feel free to stop by the Computer Lab in the Lobby to make cards and fill out the releases before coming in for drop-in hours.

item.description:
Date: Monday, November 2, 2026
Time: 6:00PM - 7:00PM
Location: North End - Upper Level
Type: Lafayette Library

Adults - drop by the Library to chat with fellow writers of all levels about your projects, share experiences with writing and getting published, get ideas for development of a piece, and learn from each other in a casual atmosphere.

Questions? Contact the Programs Staff.

Location: upstairs at the North End seating area.

item.title: Makerspace - Drop In
item.description:
Date: Tuesday, November 3, 2026
Time: 3:30PM - 7:30PM
Location: Studio 775 Makerspace
Type: Lafayette Library

Makerspace drop in is open to all ages; children in grades 5 and below must be under the direct supervision of a person over the age of 17 years old. Learn about the equipment we have, programs we offer, and tools available for making designs. Please note that hours can change due to staffing or special programs. We encourage you to check the calendar or call 303-661-1163 just ahead of your visit. Learn more about our Studio 775 Makerspace: https://lafayetteco.gov/Makerspace

Before your first use of the equipment: A release must be on file for each person of any age using the space or supervising others in the space, and each user needs their own Lafayette Library card (not an online temporary account) prior to filling out the Makerspace Release and Policies form (https://lafayetteco.gov/MakerspaceRelease). Feel free to stop by the Computer Lab in the Lobby to make cards and fill out the releases before coming in for drop-in hours.
